name: Kagura Izumi
source:
A girl from a family of Firefolk who has been fighting the Light Hunters since ancient times.

Members of her family are especially unique for their red eyes.
She’s a third-year and normally serves as the head of Oumidai Academy’s Astronomy Club.

Her gentle nature doesn’t stop her from serving as a strong leader in combat.

She has a tendency to be excessively self-conscious.

Her ability is Mend, the power to heal wounds.

Her weapon is a large scythe called the World Splitter.

(from Kagura Games' store)
